assessment: In this important study, the authors found, with the use of statistical methods, that compound heterozygous rare deletion variants affecting the kinase-domain of non-receptor tyrosine kinase TNK2/ACK1 and PTK6/BRK are associated with human systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). The authors use a convincing mouse experimental model and human-induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-derived macrophages to clarify cause-effect relationships and the cellular basis of nephritis. With the identification of new SLE-related genes, this manuscript improves our understanding of human SLE pathogenesis.
